US aircraft disabled the merchant ship Pacific Archer in the Gulf of Oman, saying it tried to run the blockade of Iranian ports; it is the first ship disabled since 7 November.
Kuwait summoned Iran's ambassador over the drone attack that killed two Italian technicians; Italy says Kuwaiti investigators found the drone was Iranian-made, and Iran denies launching it.
Moscow's mayor said 462 drones flew toward the capital region overnight; Vnukovo and Domodedovo airports suspended flights.
A Russian strike on businesses in Nizhyn, in Ukraine's Chernihiv region, killed seven people.
Ukraine offered Russia a Black Sea ceasefire to protect grain exports and awaits a reply; Moscow wants oil shipments included.
Armed people seized a cargo ship 64 nautical miles off Balhaf, Yemen, UKMTO said; no group was named.
The Financial Times reports US forces repelled about six drones swarming RAF Lakenheath in England on 13 November, with Iran suspected.
Taiwan voted in local elections as its defence ministry counted about 33 Chinese military aircraft sorties over two days.
